goal: Wave 2 build: Workspace edit engine as pure functions; Agent action admissions table and pinned owner actions

slices.title: Workspace edit engine as pure functions
slices.summary: Adds execution-core workspace_edit.rs with read, grep, glob, list, edit and put under a canonical root: sha256 version tokens, closed EditError codes, EOL, BOM and mode preservation, a 1 MiB edit cap and atomic temp-plus-rename writes, plus a per-workspace RwLock on HydratedWorkspace. Pure file operations with no network, gRPC, sandbox lease or tool bridge.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib workspace_edit && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test workspace_edit_contract
slices.notes: Dependency notes: WS08 resolved to WS08-S2 WS26 resolved to WS26-S2

slices.title: Agent action admissions table and pinned owner actions
slices.summary: Adds a capability-core agent_action_admissions table (status enabled, declared or retired) behind MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION, served as a signed model-action-view-v2 beside v1, with tickets.create byte-identical under tickets_only. Execution-core admits a server-resolved owner action only when OWNER_ACTION_PINS pins its name, schema hash, parameters and adapter (new owner_actions.rs). Per K3-25 a table row alone admits nothing: the pin and the owner verifier are also required.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib owner_actions
slices.flag: MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION=tickets_only|table (capability-core and execution-core; default tickets_only, table on the proof stack)

decisions_defaults.DEC-25: Typed side map `Record<ActionId, ModelAccessEntry>`. The 7 ids stay listed with `executor: none` as visible debt, then demoted per id; `org.*` lifecycle actions need Control-owner review before any agent calls them. Hash: `owner_contract` for `tickets.create`,
